target: Gaussian shell distribution with mean and width as conditioning variables

dense_grid.aggregation: mean over five frozen fits; sample SD across per-fit condition means

simplicity_ablation.note: The retained onebody_linear variant is evaluated in the combined campaign.

limitations: Width response is imperfect; coordinate clamping is reported in the analysis record.
The dense grid is a post-selection diagnostic.
The correlated input state is part of the model resource; no quantum advantage claim is made.
